comments.author: ShitaiA
comments.body:
problem with MF is about the crew numbers.. you will always need to add crews numbers to use the max power of the cannons. it is not top of the line ship.. could be use in some npc training or term fight as support.

you need a minium number of the cews+ your cannon numbers to max the fire power. if the crew numbers goes below it. power will drop for like 15% for every 1 crews~15% loss (from japanese wiki). which means you need to add lots of crews for the use of your cannons.
lets say if you are using 5x14 cannons.. min crews needs 40.. i.e. you need a min of 110 crews + a few spares crews in case you have some being killed/jumped over board.
5x16 cannons needs 120 + a few more.

case 1: Improved gun port + Cooperation enhancement
main.php?id=192&fs=17327
this gives better base prefermance.. more dura.. total 120 crews: good enought for using 5x14 cannons. but the CE skill only work if you are in fleet

case 1b: Improved gun port + Cooperation enhancement
main.php?id=192&fs=17330
28 crews total allow you to use 5x16 cannons

Case 2: Improved gun port + heavy bombing
main.php?id=192&fs=17329
120 crews are only enough for 5x14 cannons.. but heavy bombing work fine in both solo/fleet, if you know how to use it cleverly.

comments.author: Nicola
comments.body: Not sure why Junchul got such a vehement response. His post was pretty much spot on. I have a 6/6 royal frigate, modded well. I wanted to see for myself how the ship performs. I like the ship, I _want_ to really like the ship, but it just doesn't stack up to a 6/6 vaisseau imo. Modified Frigates are essencially the same ship as a Royal Frigate except they have a bigger hold, so they're a bit slower. This is not the ship you want to use against pirates who are trying to board. Their strength (boarding) works directly against your weakness (crew size, no defensive ship skills). If you can somehow manage to keep away from them AND their aide (they will bring him in to try to corner you up or catch you in a crit), you might have a chance, but there again you are trying to play keep-away and all they have to do is escape the ring.
